title: nf-core/taxprofiler pipeline - params.database schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.database

tool.errorMessage: Invalid tool name. Please see documentation for all supported profilers. Currently these classifers are included: motus4, motus3, cayman, gqlib, idtaxa.

db_name.description: Name of the database, unique per tool (or, for cayman and gqlib, per tool and annot_db_name). For cayman and gqlib, the reads are aligned only once to each gene catalogue: the rows with the same db_name and db_path share the alignment, also between cayman and gqlib.
db_name.errorMessage: The unique name of the database should be provided.

db_params.errorMessage: Invalid database db_params entry. No quotes allowed.

db_path.description: Path to the database. For motus4 and motus3, the db_mOTU directory (or a .tar.gz of it). For cayman and gqlib, the gene catalogue fasta that the reads are aligned to with bwa mem: the bwa index files <fasta>.amb, .ann, .bwt, .pac, .sa must be in the same directory (the pipeline does not build them, they must be created beforehand with `bwa index <fasta>`); the fasta itself is not read, only used to locate the index files, but it must exist.
db_path.errorMessage: db_path should be either a file path or a directory.

annot_db_name.description: Name of the annotation, unique per tool and db_name. Only used by cayman and gqlib, for which it is required. Several annotations of the same gene catalogue (db_name and db_path) are profiled from a single alignment: give each its own row with the same db_name and db_path and a different annot_db_name. Leave empty for the other tools.
annot_db_name.errorMessage: Invalid annot_db_name. It must not contain whitespace. Only used by cayman and gqlib.

annot_db_path.description: Path to the annotation file of the gene catalogue in db_path, passed to the profiler: the .csv annotation table for cayman, the .sqlite3 database for gqlib. Only used by cayman and gqlib, for which it is required. Leave empty for the other tools.
annot_db_path.errorMessage: annot_db_path should be the path to an existing file. Only used by cayman and gqlib.
